scope.title: Publication authority and recovery
scope.boundary: Workflow-start authority, exact candidate binding and recovery. Fixtures use initiating run facts without human approval responses. No fixture proves remote configuration or live publication.

initial_state: authority_fixture(): candidate a repeated 64, workflow-start-v1 initiation for run 12, source b repeated 40 on refs/heads/main; repository xiongxianfei/rigorloop id 7; run 12 attempt 1, push, in_progress; artifact 13 with digest sha256:c repeated 64; protected main and release environment 9 without required reviewers or waiting rules. Each mutation owns a deep copy.

ReleaseExecutorTests.setUp creates real source/prepared commits, source bundle, two small target ZIPs, exact retained provider ZIP and digest, fake package bytes clearly excluded from package validity proof, matching FixtureReleaseAuthority/FixturePublisher, and a private bare Git evidence ref.

Initiation, source, artifact and environment facts plus protected main branch, settings evidence_ref=refs/heads/release-evidence and trusted_publisher=github:xiongxianfei/rigorloop:release.yml:release; event run_id=12, source=b repeated 40, source_ref=refs/heads/main, attempt=1.
fixtures.limitation: Fixture implementation retired with the explicitly reduced regression suite; initial_state remains scenario intent, not executed proof.

initial_state: The real-build fixture in candidate-identity.json, invoked through actual coordinator dispatch with FixtureHostedServices and local bare Git evidence.

cases.title: Only an authorized release start bound to qualified retained bytes permits publication
cases.risk: An unrelated trigger or changed candidate is accepted as publication authority.

conditions: Use exact repository, workflow, main-push event, source/configuration, run and candidate/artifact facts from a permitted initiation. No human approval response is supplied.
Independently substitute a PR/local/unsupported event, wrong repository/source/run/configuration, CI-only candidate or changed retained bytes.

when: Execute candidate admission and inspect actual provider writes.
then: A permitted start with the correctly bound qualified packages proceeds without a reviewer or approval-provider query.
Each unsupported trigger, mismatched binding, failed check or changed package blocks writes; naming a version or passing a local check cannot grant authority.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Durable evidence is established before publication and preserves neighbors
cases.risk: Concurrent reporting loses another release observation.

conditions: Use executor with a private bare Git evidence ref, a neighboring release and independent expected head. Inject a ref conflict, source-ref collision or initial persistence failure.

when: Persist the initial attempt and execute publication when persistence succeeds; repeat with each storage fault.
then: Compare-and-swap writes preserve neighboring releases and cannot target the source branch.
Failed initial durable recording prevents every publication write.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Concurrent or duplicate evidence writes cannot take over an active attempt
cases.risk: Two attempts race after observing an absent immutable boundary.

conditions: Use executor with an already active durable attempt; separately mirror identical and conflicting evidence bytes.

when: Start a competing execution and exercise the actual evidence mirror.
then: The active attempt excludes a competing writer. Identical mirrored bytes are reusable; conflicting bytes stop without overwrite.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Lost reporting preserves publication observations and requires safe recovery
cases.risk: Lost reporting erases the public-write fact and causes another publication.

conditions: Use executor. Fail persistence after a public write; separately resume without its retained observation artifact.

when: Execute, inspect preserved observations/failure status and retry unchanged inputs through actual recovery.
then: A public write followed by reporting failure remains incomplete closeout; observations are retained.
Retry never republishes the completed immutable operation. Missing recovery observations require intervention rather than inferred success.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: One authorized start completes the routine path without later approval
cases.risk: The composed workflow still waits for a second confirmation, rebuilds packages or publishes twice.

conditions: Use real preparation/build/coordinator dispatch with an authorized main-push event, retained artifacts and controlled publication/evidence services. No required-reviewer grant exists.

when: Drive preparation through checks, publication and public closeout; repeat the original run against the same candidate and inspect write history.
Independently fail a required check before execution and verify no publication is attempted.
then: Successful qualification automatically leads to publishing the retained packages and recording public outcomes without a later human action.
Workflow, setup and executor use event/source/configuration binding; no approval-provider call or waiting review gate is present.
Failed checks block dependent publication. Repeated delivery observes matching public state and performs no duplicate immutable write.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Missing permitted source setup or runtime credentials blocks publication
cases.risk: Removing environment reviewer checks also removes source, trigger or authentication restrictions.

conditions: Use permitted main-push source policy, evidence ref and trusted-publisher configuration; omit each necessary prerequisite independently. Required environment reviewers are absent by design.

when: Inspect setup and enter the coordinator with each variant.
then: Absence of a second approval is valid. Missing source protection, unsupported workflow/event or missing required credentials blocks publication with a precise diagnostic.
Runtime authority is checked without inferring it from a setup declaration or local success.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Unknown or uncertain publication is resolved by bounded observation before retry
cases.risk: Unavailable or delayed public state causes an unbounded wait, false success or duplicate immutable publication.

conditions: Use executor with known prior boundaries. Independently make initial npm state unavailable, lose a write response, time out a subprocess, or hide the post-write identity until the last observation or beyond the limit.
For exhaustion count observations after the write: tag/GitHub allow six with waits 0..4; npm allows 121 with waits 0..119. Use controlled waits without sleeping.

when: Execute and inspect write/observation history and durable attempt state.
Expose the matching committed identity after uncertainty, then retry unchanged inputs. Also supply an unknown stored state or execution boundary.
then: Unobservable initial state grants no write permission. A lost response is resolved from actual public state, never by blind republish.
Matching identity on the last admitted observation permits progress. Exhaustion records uncertain-publication and its boundary, clears active execution, performs no extra wait or later write.
Retry observes the committed identity and resumes without repeating its immutable write. Unknown execution state/boundary rejects.

gaps: Visibility exhaustion stops at its exact boundary and recovers by observation: Existing tests cover npm success on observation 121 and unknown tag outcome; add explicit exhaustion counts and recovery at every boundary.
Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Partial GitHub assets resume only the missing operation
cases.risk: Incomplete asset publication restarts every boundary.

conditions: Prepublish matching tag/GitHub data, remove one observed GitHub asset and clear the call history while retaining public state.

then: Write history is exactly [github, npm]; the matching tag is not written again.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Failed smoke or changed public identity leaves publication failed until corrected
cases.risk: Successful initial writes conceal failed public installation or identity drift during closeout.

conditions: Use executor after matching publication. Independently fail smoke, mismatch installed tree, or change npm dist-tag from candidate 0.5.1 to 0.5.0 during smoke before final observation.

when: Finish closeout, inspect failure evidence, then repair only the failed observation and retry the unchanged candidate.
then: Persist failed-after-publication and retain published identity and failure history; no completed status is recorded while smoke, installed bytes or final public identity disagree.
Retry repairs closeout by observation; publication writes are not repeated.

gaps: Public identity changes during smoke prevent completed closeout: Add an explicit change during closeout; initial conflict and installed-tree mismatch tests cover different boundaries.

cases.title: Actual CLI diagnostics suppress private failure details
cases.risk: Exception formatting leaks local secrets or converts an operational failure to success.

conditions: For read-evidence and prepare, inject controlled OSError, missing-input and malformed-input failures with a private diagnostic path.

when: Invoke the real dispatcher with controlled services; capture stderr and any GitHub summary file.
then: Every variant reports failure and excludes private paths from user-visible output.
A filesystem errno may be reported without its path; failures cannot produce a ready candidate.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.

cases.title: Loss of execution authority between boundaries stops subsequent writes
cases.risk: An initial authorized start is treated as unlimited permission after execution authority is lost.

conditions: Allow matching tag publication, then make the current run cancelled or its required runtime authority unavailable before the next boundary. Keep the candidate unchanged.

when: Continue execution while inspecting current execution authority; do not query reviewer approval facts.
then: Stop before later GitHub/npm writes when authority loss is observed; retain the completed tag outcome and report incomplete publication. Cancellation does not erase a committed write.

gaps: Automated realization removed under the maintainer-selected minimal suite. This scenario is not claimed covered by the retained suite; see design/support/validation.md.
